avis.titre: Perfect toner for sensitive, easily irritated skin types
avis.texte: This is my go-to toner -- I use their glutathione niacinamide sunscreen and toner pads, as well. My skin is hyper-sensitive that reacts to literally everything, and this toner calms it down every time while also making it hydrated. Glutathione is an antioxidant that (supposedly!) helps protect the skin, while niacinamide/B3 strengthens the barrier and reduces redness. I think this brand does a perfect combo of it. If you're using a retinoid, it's a good pairing without irritating your skin. Highly recommend it.
I have been using this in my nighttime routine for about a year now. It leaves the skin feeling hydrated and youthful. Great product.
I really enjoyed this toner. I did not see any huge change in my skin, but it is great in combination with other products. It absorbs well helps keep the skin balanced.
This is a new must have in my skincare. It feels like medicine.
I have sensitive skin so i appreciate the ingredients. However, it takes several swipes over the same area to remove residual makeup (which I always use sparingly anyway).
しっとりするのにベタつかず、肌がなめらかに整う感じ。敏感なときも刺激なく使えて、重ねづけしてもモロモロ出ないのが嬉しい。リーズナブルで気軽に試せる一本です。 ￼

This Glutathione Niacinamide Toner has a great formula with MANY quality ingredients designed to work magic on your skin. This toner does what a toner is supposed to do - removes left behind dirt & make-up from your face & preps your skin for the rest of your beauty routine. The bottle is generously priced. I have no complaints!

avis.titre: it’s a good toner for sensitive skin
avis.texte: I’ve tried and used a number of toners over the years, for a while i’ve been using thayers witch hazel rose toner which has been my goto toner when my skin reacts badly to a toner i had tried because i know it’s gentle enough. that being said this toner isn’t like a toner toner that removes a lot of dead skin it’s more of a laneige toner & moisturizer. it’s great but i think given that it’s summer ive only liked using it after i’ve showered in the morning because i feel like at night i get build up from sweat/pollution due to humidity and whatnot and need something stronger. that being said if you’re someone who had super sensitive skin or skin that dries out easily, you will likely love this. overall it’s a good toner at a very reasonable price with a nice formulation.
This has been a decent product. It doesn't do a whole lot for oil reduction but has helped with moisturizing after a shower. It doesn't smell the greatest though.

avis.titre: Clears skin without feeling tight and itchy
avis.texte: I’ve been using this toner after my daily double cleanse, and feel it leaves my face feeling refreshed without the typical tightness I find toners leave behind. I shake it well and use a cotton round to tap it into my face, making sure to get my nose really well, and can see a difference in the couple weeks I’ve been using it so far. I would recommend this product as it seems gentle, effective and overall great for the price.

This system is so refreshing! Having mixed combo skin, finding hydrating products with GOOD ingredients that don’t make your face shiny is really hard to find. I’ve been using these for almost two weeks and I can clearly see a difference in my skin. The Toner and Mist are refreshing and tightening without drying out your face. I love that. I’m happy to have found this before the summer, now that I don’t really have a need for makeup after using these. Awesome products. Thanks! 🌻

avis.titre: Gentle enough to be used multiple times a day without drying
avis.texte: Makes my skin feel so so so refreshed and supple without drying or making me greasy or shiny. Just a little bit goes a long way and I put this on cotton swabs and dab all over my face and T zone as a refresh as needed throughout the day.
It is milky and not too sticky nor greasy. I like its refreshing texture. My skin looks brighter and smoother. Great!
My skin feels clean and taen care of. No strong smell whatsoever. Great addition to my daily skin routine.
